newsitem.title: ITALY: Heavylift flies assembly line parts ex-Turin to Windsor.
newsitem.headline: Heavylift flies assembly line parts ex-Turin to Windsor.

text.p: Two Antonov-124 freighters were used to move 120 tonnes of engine assembly line equipment from Turin's Caselle airport to the Ford Motor Co F.N. plant in Windsor, Ontario, Italian freight forwarder Zust Ambrosetti Trasporti Internazionali told Reuters.
The aircraft operated by HeavyLift-Volga Dnepr were given permission to land at Windsor airport in Canada, rather than at Detroit, due to its closeness to the plant, Zust added.

The shipments valued at $4.47 million, formed the last phase of a three month contract for the movement by road, sea and air of 6,000 cubic metres and 1,300 tonnes of assembly line equipment -- worth $44.8 million -- manufactured by Fiat Spa subsidiary, Comau Spa for Ford, the forwarder said.
The UK-based Anglo-Russian Heavylift is a member of the Norwegian industrial group, Kvaerner ASA. --Reuter Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
